The sensory associations are interesting – sight, sound, smell, taste, touch – all linked to this single digit.

I can see the original 5, a hook shape with a horizontal top stroke and a curve at the bottom. Now, imagine that image flipped, facing the opposite direction. When I look at it, this fused symbol reminds me of an anchor! It's solid, balanced, and has a strong visual presence. I could also say it looks like a stylized coat of arms or an ancient rune.
